text_block_list.text:
The Osaka Hai. The momentous race that will divine the fortunes of this year is
finally about to begin.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, that okonomiyaki last night
was delicious, wasn't it~?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
They let me slice it across the griddle
and serve it with a "Here you go!"...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I feel so energized now~.
I think I can do it today!
"Super Creek's way is to draw strength not from eating, but from pampering others. And so—"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo~!
Mind if I barge in, Creek?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Umm... Was I scheduled to run today?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, just dropping by with some encouragement.
Figured I'd see what kind of performance you put on.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Our real showdown is next. Creek,
you'd better hurry up and push past this.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll be waitin'--at the Tenno Sho (Spring)!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: An Osaka specialty: spring roll tempura...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell no! It's the spring 'Tenno Sho'!
Don't go playin' the fool during the race, got it?!
